15-s164.condition: Unit 4, Progress Check, Part I, упр. 15, с. 164. Напиши письмо подруге по переписке и ответь на её вопросы.
steps: Dear Kate,
Thank you for your letter. I'm sorry I haven't written for so long.
You asked me about my pets. I have a dog called Rex. He is clever and friendly. I walk him every day. My family is not big: my parents, my sister and me. We get on well. My hobby is drawing.
What about you? Write soon. Love, Anna.
15-s164.answer: Письмо: питомец, семья, хобби + вопрос подруге
